blocks.text: SCAN moves to the physical edge before reversing; LOOK reverses at the last request. C-SCAN services in one direction only and wraps; C-LOOK wraps between extreme requests instead of disk edges.

blocks.text: SCAN/LOOK trade a little extra travel for fairness: nobody waits an entire sweep. SSTF plays shortest-job-first on cylinders — fast on average, but a far request can starve. FCFS is the honest baseline every distance calculation starts from.
Head 53, queue `98 183 37 122 14 124 65 67`: SCAN (right) = **331**, LOOK (right) = **299**, SSTF = **236**, FCFS = **640**. The SCAN–LOOK gap is exactly the edge detour ×2.
